settings.label: building since — early builds still ridden

settings.question: Can I really ride it in the rain every day?
settings.answer: Yes. Finished frames are sealed with a weatherproof epoxy lacquer. Dry your bike after wet rides and store it indoors, and it'll give you years of riding — many of our earliest builds are still ridden daily.

settings.question: How much maintenance does a bamboo commuter need?
settings.answer: Very little. Build it single-speed and there's almost nothing to service — no derailleur to adjust. Keep the chain clean, dry the frame after wet rides, and inspect the joints once a year. That's it.

settings.question: Will it handle hills and city traffic?
settings.answer: The frame is single-speed or hub-gear ready, so you can spec gearing to suit your route and hills. The upright geometry gives you excellent visibility in traffic, and it fits standard racks, mudguards and lights.

settings.question: Is it strong and secure enough for daily city use?
settings.answer: Very strong for its weight. Bamboo is a light, hollow natural composite and every joint is reinforced with carbon-fibre, giving a high strength-to-weight ratio. Our bamboo is independently tested at Swansea University. Builders ride these frames daily and tour continents — with proper care they last for years.

settings.question: Can I get it through Cycle to Work?
settings.answer: Yes. Our frame kits are eligible for standard Cycle to Work schemes — UK employees typically save 25–39% through salary sacrifice. We accept Cyclescheme, Cycle Solutions, Evans and Halfords.
